label: Using reference angles to rewrite angles
subgoals: Measure theta against the nearest horizontal axis
Reduce theta modulo 2pi to a base form
Assign the quadrant sign to each function

label: Reduction formulas for \\( \pi/2 + \alpha \\)
subgoals: Locate pi/2 + alpha in the second quadrant
Exchange sine with cosine across the vertical axis
Negate the cosine while sine stays positive

label: Reduction formulas for \\( \pi/2 - \alpha \\)
subgoals: Locate pi/2 - alpha in the first quadrant
Exchange sine with cosine with no sign change
Carry tan/cot along via the sine-cosine swap
